about: The data of the load window (widget LoadGame): ExistingSaves (ls.VMSavegame), ExistingPlaythroughs (ls.VMPlaythroughHolder: ProtagonistName, PlaythroughString, LatestSave, Saves), SelectedPlaythrough (the playthrough of the newest save when the window opens), HasSaveGames. Of a save it holds Title, TimeString, LevelName, MainModName, Difficulty and the screenshot, and of the avatar only its name.

evidence.says: GetAllProperties of GK.Gui.Data('LoadGame') in the main menu lists these properties; SelectedPlaythrough.LatestSave.TimeString equals the newest TimeString of ExistingSaves and the newest folder of gatekit save list
